story_metadata.title: Anjaan Chehra: Har Shehar Mein Nazar Aata Hai
story_metadata.hook_line: क्या होगा अगर हर शहर के CCTV में एक चेहरा दिखे?
story_metadata.twist_reveal: The face belongs to a time traveler warning about an impending disaster.
story_metadata.moral: Things are not always what they seem.
story_metadata.moral_hindi: हर चीज़ वैसी नहीं होती जैसी दिखती है।

scenes.voiceover_hindi: Kya hoga agar har shehar ke CCTV mein ek hi chehra dikhe?
scenes.ai_prompt: Wide-angle city view with multiple CCTV cameras focused on one mysterious face. Noir style, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, atmospheric fog.

scenes.voiceover_hindi: Yeh chehra har din har camera mein dikhayi padta hai.
scenes.ai_prompt: Close-up of CCTV monitors, all displaying the same mysterious face. Mood: Intriguing, eerie.

scenes.voiceover_hindi: Detective Raj ne is chehre ki talaash shuru ki.
scenes.ai_prompt: Detective with a determined expression pinning pictures of the face on a board. Noir style.

scenes.voiceover_hindi: Kya yeh ek ghost hai ya kisi technology ka chamatkar?
scenes.ai_prompt: A shadowy figure standing in mist, face obscured, with digital glitch effects around. Suspenseful mood.

scenes.voiceover_hindi: Detective Raj ne purani tasviron ki jaanch ki aur pareshan ho gaya.
scenes.ai_prompt: Detective in dimly lit room going through old photographs, troubled expression.

scenes.voiceover_hindi: Yeh chehra har zamane mein dekha gaya hai.
scenes.ai_prompt: Collage of historical photos with the same mysterious face present in each era. Time-travel hint.

scenes.voiceover_hindi: Asal mein yeh ek time-traveler hai, logon ko bachaane aaya hai.
scenes.ai_prompt: Revealing the mysterious face as a time traveler, futuristic device in hand, concerned expression.

scenes.voiceover_hindi: Har cheez vaise nahi hoti jaise dikhti hai.
scenes.ai_prompt: A symbolic image of an hourglass with faces trapped inside, representing mystery and time. Atmospheric fog.
